SHk6ba_1a8WXhng72szpzA.zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,今年迄 4/11 累計報告 5,506 例病例,其中 831 例確診,主要分布於薩爾塔省;美洲地區累計報告病例數以巴西及玻利維亞為多。
SHk6ba_1a8WXhng72szpzA.en: Argentina's outbreak update: as of 11 April this year, 5,506 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 831 confirmed cases, mainly in Salta Province. Across the Americas, Brazil and Bolivia have reported the most cumulative cases.

jJeyd2x3AlCc8WkJ3y_foA.zh: 玻利維亞東部聖克魯斯省於今年 4 月發布健康警報,由於科迪勒拉縣報告 2 例確診病例,其中 1 例死亡,另於同省之查拉瓜鎮報告 1 例疑病例,當局已展開大規模預防接種運動;該國於 2023-2025 年每年報告 5-8 例病例(其中 2-4 例死亡)。
jJeyd2x3AlCc8WkJ3y_foA.en: Santa Cruz Department in eastern Bolivia issued a health alert in April this year. Two confirmed cases, one of them fatal, have been reported in Cordillera Province, and one suspected case has been reported in the town of Charagua in the same department. Authorities have launched a large-scale vaccination campaign. Bolivia reported 5–8 cases a year in 2023–2025, of which 2–4 were fatal.

V9UpINWc8y_92_BfuphJ2g.zh: 玻利維亞南部塔里哈省今年報告2例病例且皆已死亡,分別為30歲及36歲男性,從事農漁業,均有囓齒動物接觸史。該國去年報告48例漢他病毒肺症候群病例,其中塔里哈省報告15例。
V9UpINWc8y_92_BfuphJ2g.en: In Tarija Department in southern Bolivia, two cases have been reported this year, both fatal, in men aged 30 and 36 who work in agriculture and fishing; both had a history of contact with rodents. Last year, Bolivia reported 48 cases of hantavirus pulmonary syndrome, 15 of them in Tarija Department.

NvS-hcBUZ5vJ-e-81vEZDg.zh: 美洲地區今年1-7週共4國累計34例確診病例及15例死亡(CFR:44%),分布於哥倫比亞(25例病例及13例死亡)、委內瑞拉(6例病例及1例死亡)、玻利維亞(1例死亡)及秘魯(2例病例)。自2024年9月以來,病例已發生於先前無疫情傳播地區,如亞馬遜雨林以外地區,泛美衛生組織(PAHO)發布警報,呼籲各國加強監測及疫苗接種等措施。
NvS-hcBUZ5vJ-e-81vEZDg.en: In the Americas, weeks 1–7 of this year, 4 countries reported a cumulative 34 confirmed cases and 15 deaths (CFR: 44%), distributed as follows: Colombia (25 cases and 13 deaths), Venezuela (6 cases and 1 death), Bolivia (1 death) and Peru (2 cases). Since September 2024, cases have occurred in areas with no previous transmission, including areas outside the Amazon rainforest. The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has issued an alert and called on countries to strengthen surveillance, vaccination and other measures.

pyr6ODY6DUzv7jWww4IHKw.zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,本季報告2,217例疑病例,西北部薩爾塔省於今年截至第8週報告36例病例(29例確診),分布於該省不同地區,主要為44-65歲族群。自2025年底以來,美洲地區疫情上升,鄰近之玻利維亞病例數上升,導致阿根廷多地發生境外移入病例,後續亦出現本土傳播病例。
pyr6ODY6DUzv7jWww4IHKw.en: Argentina's epidemic update: this season, 2,217 suspected cases have been reported. In Salta Province in the northwest, 36 cases (29 confirmed) were reported as of week 8 this year, distributed across different parts of the province, mainly in the 44–65 age group. Since late 2025, case numbers in the Americas have risen, and case numbers in neighbouring Bolivia have increased, leading to imported cases in several parts of Argentina, followed by locally acquired cases.

-bkQlaT-jJVITjqa9B5RAQ.zh: 玻利維亞疫情更新,今年1-7週累計報告5,518例病例(3,976例確診),迄今已有至少37例住院及4例死亡,該國東部聖克魯斯省病例數持續上升,近1週新增約1,000例病例。
-bkQlaT-jJVITjqa9B5RAQ.en: Bolivia's epidemic update: in weeks 1–7 this year, 5,518 cases were reported cumulatively (3,976 confirmed), with at least 37 hospitalized and 4 deaths. Case numbers continue to rise in Santa Cruz Department in the east, with about 1,000 new cases added in the past week.

1RpUyy5NiNuqOnzMR8MVaA.zh: 蘇利南疫情更新,於去年底報告自2016年以來首例本土病例,迄今年1月底累計712例疑病例(327例確診)及1例死亡,以北部巴拉馬利波區之確診病例數為多。 玻利維亞發生疫情,該國今年1-5週累計報告1,534例病例,其中以東部聖克魯斯省1,409例最多,該省近1週另新增1,515例病例,截至2月中已累計報告3,004例。該國去年累計報告近7,000例病例及4例死亡,美國CDC近期提升該國疫情旅遊警示至第2級。 古巴疫情持續,今年1月累計報告1,457例病例(114例確診)及2例死亡,去年累計報告51,217例病例(近2,000例確診)及46例死亡。
1RpUyy5NiNuqOnzMR8MVaA.en: Suriname's epidemic update: at the end of last year, the first locally acquired case since 2016 was reported. As of the end of January this year, 712 suspected cases (327 confirmed) and 1 death have been reported cumulatively, with the most confirmed cases in Paramaribo District in the north. Bolivia's outbreak continues: in weeks 1–5 this year, 1,534 cases were reported cumulatively, of which 1,409 were in the eastern Santa Cruz Department, the most of any area. In the past week, that department added a further 1,515 cases, and 3,004 cases had been reported cumulatively by mid-February. Last year Bolivia reported nearly 7,000 cases and 4 deaths, and the US CDC recently raised its travel notice for the country to Level 2. Cuba's outbreak continues: 1,457 cases (114 confirmed) and 2 deaths were reported cumulatively in January this year; last year, 51,217 cases (nearly 2,000 confirmed) and 46 deaths were reported cumulatively.

-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.zh: PAHO針對美洲區發布麻疹疫情警報,今(2026)年美洲區第1-3週共7國報告1,031例確定病例,分別為墨西哥(740例)、美國(171例)、加拿大(67例)、瓜地馬拉(41例)、玻利維亞(10例)、智利(1例)及烏拉圭(1例),較去(2025)年同期(23例)增加43倍,其中73%病患未接種疫苗,11%病患接種史不明,病例主要集中於青少年及青年族群中,另發病率以1歲以下嬰兒為高,其次為1-4歲及5-9歲兒童;去年該地區共計13國報告14,891例確定病例,2024年報告466例,近5年病例數持續增加,且多個國家持續出現疫情。PAHO呼籲各國加強流行病學監測、疫苗接種及緊急疫情防控措施,以阻斷疫情傳播。 歐洲去年共計30國報告7,655例病例,其中8例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(4,198例)、法國(877例)、荷蘭(534例)、義大利(529例)及西班牙(426例)為多,其中79.9%病患未接種疫苗,病例數以5歲以下年齡層為多(佔40%),ECDC表示去年病例數較2024年(逾3.5萬例)下降,惟仍約2023年病例數兩倍,由於麻疹感染人數通常於冬末春初達到高峰,呼籲民眾檢視自身已完成疫苗接種。 哈薩克今年1月報告1,951例確定病例,病例數以中北部阿斯塔納州(581例)、東南部江布爾州(339例)及東南部阿拉木圖市(317例)為多,其中79%病患未接種疫苗,當局表示拒絕接種疫苗為疫情爆發主因,當局呼籲家長確認孩童疫苗接種情形,並依照國家免疫計畫及時接種疫苗;該國西部阿克托別州疫情嚴峻,單月報告逾百名病例,以3歲以下年齡層為主,其中24例兒童住院治療中。
-pw8ozEkBzxxrnU8Lwugyg.en: PAHO issued a measles outbreak alert for the Americas. In weeks 1–3 of this year, 7 countries in the Americas reported 1,031 confirmed cases: Mexico (740), the United States (171), Canada (67), Guatemala (41), Bolivia (10), Chile (1) and Uruguay (1). This is a 43-fold increase over the 23 cases in the same period last year. Of these cases, 73% were unvaccinated and 11% had unknown vaccination history. Cases were mainly concentrated among adolescents and young adults, and incidence was highest among infants under 1 year, followed by children aged 1–4 and 5–9 years. Last year, 13 countries in the region reported 14,891 confirmed cases, compared with 466 in 2024; cases have continued to increase over the past five years, and many countries continue to report outbreaks. PAHO calls on countries to strengthen epidemiological surveillance, vaccination and emergency outbreak control measures to stop transmission. Europe reported 7,655 cases across 30 countries last year, including 8 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Romania (4,198), France (877), the Netherlands (534), Italy (529) and Spain (426). Of these, 79.9% were unvaccinated, and cases were most numerous among children under 5 years (40%). ECDC said last year's case numbers declined from 2024 (more than 35,000), but remain about twice the 2023 level. Because measles infections usually peak in late winter and early spring, it urges people to check that they have completed their vaccinations. Kazakhstan reported 1,951 confirmed cases in January this year, most in Astana (581), Zhambyl Region in the southeast (339) and Almaty city in the southeast (317). Of these, 79% were unvaccinated. Authorities say refusal of vaccination is the main cause of the outbreak, and urge parents to confirm children's vaccination status and vaccinate them promptly under the national immunization programme. The outbreak is severe in Aktobe Region in the west, which reported more than 100 cases in a single month, mainly among children under 3 years; 24 children are being treated in hospital.

xuuP-mSEFL1TLYYOYNSvTA.zh: 南美洲玻利維亞11/8報告1例死亡病例,為24歲女實習醫學生,在鄉村醫療服務時,曾接觸3個月大幼犬,於10/31出現腦膜炎症狀就醫,於11/2轉診途中去世。該病可能透過唾液傳播,當局刻正調查中,並啟動犬隻疫苗接種活動。
xuuP-mSEFL1TLYYOYNSvTA.en: Bolivia reported one death on 8 November: a 24-year-old female medical intern who, while providing rural medical services, had come into contact with a three-month-old puppy. She developed meningitis-like symptoms on 31 October and sought care, and died on 2 November while being transferred for referral. The disease may be transmitted through saliva. Authorities are investigating and have launched a dog vaccination campaign.

ZudW_DkC77OGhqq7Jp5OXg.zh: 美國今年截至9/17共42州報告1,491例,其中181例住院、3例死亡,病患年齡以5-19歲占大宗。 加拿大近期疫情呈下降趨勢,第36週(8/31-9/6)新增報告53例,今年累計報告4,902例病例,病患多分布於安大略省及亞伯達省,年齡以5-17歲為多。 玻利維亞今年截至9/19累計報告逾1,500例,為南美洲病例數最多國家,分布以東部聖克魯斯省為多(佔85%),病患年齡多為1-9歲,84%病患未接種疫苗或接種情況不明。
ZudW_DkC77OGhqq7Jp5OXg.en: As of 17 September, 42 US states had reported 1,491 cases this year, including 181 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; most patients were aged 5–19 years. Canada's recent outbreak shows a declining trend: 53 new cases were reported in week 36 (31 August–6 September), and 4,902 cases have been reported cumulatively this year. Most cases are in Ontario and Alberta, and most patients are aged 5–17 years. Bolivia reported more than 1,500 cumulative cases as of 19 September, the highest number in South America. Cases are concentrated in eastern Santa Cruz Department (85%); most patients are aged 1–9 years, and 84% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status.

f1TBWf2QH2FqKtO5vbktgg.zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,近1週(8/24-30)新增225例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市119例最多,其次為廣州市49例,相較於前1週新增336例,病例數呈下降趨勢,當局持續進行疫情防治工作。 全球今年截至8月中旬累計逾270,000例病例,美洲地區累計14國報告212,029例病例及110例死亡,主要分布於南美洲(玻利維亞、巴西、巴拉圭)及部分加勒比地區,此外,於印度洋、歐洲及亞洲之持續疫情,提升不同基因型共同循環之可能性,大幅增加其再度傳播及蔓延之風險。
f1TBWf2QH2FqKtO5vbktgg.en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease: in the past week (24–30 August), 225 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 119 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 49. Compared with 336 new cases in the previous week, case numbers are declining. Authorities continue outbreak prevention and control work. Globally, as of mid-August this year, more than 270,000 cases had been cumulatively reported. The Americas region has cumulatively reported 212,029 cases and 110 deaths from 14 countries, mainly in South America (Bolivia, Brazil and Paraguay) and parts of the Caribbean. In addition, ongoing outbreaks in the Indian Ocean, Europe and Asia increase the likelihood of different genotypes circulating together, which greatly increases the risk of renewed transmission and spread.

FAMzDA2nfrnXdqiqwChhgw.zh: 玻利維亞於6/24發布公共衛生緊急狀態,該國自4月報告首例以來迄今報告60例,病例多分布於該國東部聖克魯斯省,惟近期疫情擴散至該國西部地區,當局將規劃疫苗採購及接種計畫。 蒙古今年截至6/30累計報告逾10,000例,其中648例住院及7例死亡,病例多為中學生。
FAMzDA2nfrnXdqiqwChhgw.en: Bolivia declared a public health emergency on 24 June. Since the first case was reported in April this year, 60 cases have been reported to date. Cases are mainly in Santa Cruz Department in the east, but the outbreak has recently spread to western regions. Authorities will plan vaccine procurement and vaccination programs. Mongolia has reported more than 10,000 cumulative cases as of 30 June this year, including 648 hospitalized and 7 deaths. Most cases are secondary school students.

56h2uqfEt6Z_ZOlIbdofJg.zh: 德國巴伐利亞邦爆發疫情,共報告18例,病例皆與當地5月初舉行之國際活動相關,其中12例為來自波蘭/義大利/捷克/英國之民眾;玻利維亞東部聖克魯斯省報告7例,指標病例為22歲男性,具傳染力期間曾參加大型宗教集會,因具社區傳播風險,當局發布衛生警示。隨北半球夏季即將到來,預期旅遊及大型活動增加,將提升疾病傳播及跨境感染風險。 美國亞利桑納州報告該州今年首起疫情,4例病患來自該州東部納瓦荷郡,皆未接種疫苗,近期有境外旅遊史,均來自同一感染源;該國截至6/5共34州報告17起疫情,累計1,168例病例,其中137例住院及3例死亡。
56h2uqfEt6Z_ZOlIbdofJg.en: An outbreak in Bavaria, Germany, has reported 18 cases, all linked to an international event held locally in early May; 12 of the cases were people from Poland, Italy, the Czech Republic and the United Kingdom. In Santa Cruz Department in eastern Bolivia, 7 cases have been reported. The index case was a 22-year-old man who attended a large religious gathering during his infectious period. Because of the risk of community transmission, authorities have issued a health alert. As the northern hemisphere summer approaches, travel and large events are expected to increase, raising the risk of disease spread and cross-border infection. In the United States, Arizona reported the state's first outbreak this year: 4 patients from Navajo County in the east of the state, all unvaccinated, with recent overseas travel, all from the same source. As of 5 June, 34 states have reported 17 outbreaks in the country, with 1,168 cumulative cases, including 137 hospitalized and 3 deaths.

5CH4oLH2x-o_k4TLimkPSw.zh: 美洲地區疫情更新,今年截至第20週累計221例病例(89例死亡),今年病例數約為去年同期27例之8倍,分布於巴西、哥倫比亞、秘魯、玻利維亞及厄瓜多,去年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟今年已傳播至前揭地區以外之巴西聖保羅州及哥倫比亞托利馬省,且以未接種疫苗個案為多,評估美洲地區(尤其流行國家)風險為高。
5CH4oLH2x-o_k4TLimkPSw.en: Americas regional update: as of week 20 this year, 221 cases (89 deaths) have been reported cumulatively. This year's case count is about eight times the 27 cases reported in the same period last year. Cases are distributed in Brazil, Colombia, Peru, Bolivia and Ecuador. Last year's cases were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but this year the disease has spread beyond those areas, to São Paulo State in Brazil and Tolima Department in Colombia, and most cases were unvaccinated. The risk for the Americas, especially in endemic countries, is assessed as high.

nFeo82kGjRxr9VYN439q5g.zh: 玻利維亞今年迄今已報告超過20例,其中7例死亡,以該國北部拉巴斯省報告20例為多,另南部塔里哈省報告4例及首例死亡病例,病毒於該國多個省份持續流行,每年皆有報告病例。 美國內華達州瓦肖郡(Washoe County)報告1例,為90多歲女性,病患出現症狀前數週曾直接或間接接觸囓齒動物排遺,或於施作木工時接觸到動物巢穴,相關調查持續進行中,本案為該郡2023年8月以來首例。
nFeo82kGjRxr9VYN439q5g.en: Bolivia has reported more than 20 cases so far this year, 7 of them fatal. The largest number, 20 cases, were reported in La Paz Department in the north of the country, while Tarija Department in the south reported 4 cases and its first death. The virus continues to circulate in several provinces of the country, and cases are reported every year. In Washoe County, Nevada, USA, one case was reported in a woman in her 90s. In the weeks before symptoms began, she had direct or indirect contact with rodent droppings, or came into contact with animal nests while doing woodwork. The investigation is ongoing. This is the county's first case since August 2023.

4Q183reyS9hKIG-2GodRvA.zh: 美洲疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告7,300餘例病例,主要分布於巴西、阿根廷、玻利維亞等國;去年該洲累計報告逾4萬例病例,病例數以巴西為最多。
4Q183reyS9hKIG-2GodRvA.en: Americas update: so far this year, more than 7,300 cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in Brazil, Argentina and Bolivia. Last year the region reported more than 40,000 cases cumulatively, with Brazil having the most.

ErDra58MMvPIBu-RjQqq_A.zh: 泛美衛生組織(PAHO)發布警報,美洲近期病例數上升,2025年迄第12週累計131例病例及53例死亡,分布於巴西81例病例(31例死亡)、哥倫比亞31例病例(13例死亡)、秘魯18例病例(8例死亡)及玻利維亞1例死亡病例,大部分病例均未接種疫苗,2024年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,惟2025年已傳播至前揭地區以外之區域。
ErDra58MMvPIBu-RjQqq_A.en: The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) has issued an alert over rising yellow fever cases in the Americas. Through week 12 of 2025, 131 cases and 53 deaths have been reported cumulatively: Brazil 81 cases (31 deaths), Colombia 31 cases (13 deaths), Peru 18 cases (8 deaths) and one fatal case in Bolivia. Most cases were unvaccinated. In 2024, cases were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, but in 2025 transmission has spread beyond those areas.

JRj0JYSEysFGKKVcb3SVYg.zh: 阿根廷疫情更新,今年截至2/27累計報告288例病例,去年全年共報告564例病例;去年美洲地區以巴西、阿根廷、玻利維亞、哥倫比亞等國病例數為多,其中巴西報告42,000餘例病例。
JRj0JYSEysFGKKVcb3SVYg.en: Argentina update: as of 27 February this year, 288 cases have been reported cumulatively, compared with 564 cases for the whole of last year. Last year, case numbers in the Americas were highest in Brazil, Argentina, Bolivia, Colombia and other countries; Brazil reported over 42,000 cases.

6EBBkB1YhV46yErhnWn6Zg.zh: 美洲疫情上升,泛美衛生組織(PAHO)於2/4對美洲近期病例數上升發布警報,今年1月已報告17例病例及7例死亡。2024年累計61例病例及30例死亡,高於2022-2023年玻利維亞、巴西、哥倫比亞及秘魯等國之病例數及死亡數;2024年病例主要分布於亞馬遜雨林地區,包括玻利維亞、巴西、哥倫比亞、蓋亞那及秘魯等國,今年疾病傳播至該地區以外的區域,主要分布於巴西聖保羅州、哥倫比亞托利馬省等地區;該組織呼籲加強疫苗接種措施及疫情監測。
6EBBkB1YhV46yErhnWn6Zg.en: Cases are rising in the Americas. On 4 February, the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) issued an alert over the recent increase in cases in the region. In January this year, 17 cases and 7 deaths were reported. In 2024, 61 cases and 30 deaths were reported cumulatively, higher than the case and death numbers for 2022–2023 in countries including Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia and Peru. Cases in 2024 were mainly in the Amazon rainforest region, including Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Guyana and Peru.
